name: Binghatti Hillside
overview: Binghatti Hillside is a luxurious 25-storey residential tower developed by Binghatti Developers FZE, strategically located in Dubai Science Park. Renowned for their bold architectural identity and modernist aesthetic, Binghatti reimagines contemporary living with this striking new addition to Dubai’s skyline. The tower blends innovation, elegance, and sustainability to create an urban sanctuary. Designed with premium interiors, world-class amenities, and smart home technology, Binghatti Hillside offers a lifestyle that caters to both convenience and refined taste. It is poised to be a landmark destination for those seeking upscale living in a community focused on science, education, and forward-thinking innovation.
